name: 2349-longprompt-dsv2coderfp8-tp8
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 236B total / 21B active, 60 layers, MLA attention, 160 routed experts at top-6 plus 2 shared, FP8 with a static activation scheme
workload: synthetic_text, 1 turn, 4096 prompt tokens (stdev 256) and 32 output tokens exactly, 64 streams, no shared prefix
purpose: A 236-billion-parameter coding assistant reviewing long code files for 64 concurrent developers, returning brief verdicts, on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang 0.4.0 server arguments. Anything not named here is left at the release's stock value.

model-path: RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 8
disable-radix-cache: true

# -1 is this release's spelling for "do not chunk". At the stock 8192 a 4096-token prompt would
# be processed in two passes on some arrivals and one on others.
chunked-prefill-size: -1
